description: Header file defining the VideoDmpReader class for reading and parsing video data in DMP format, including nested classes for access units and methods for retrieving media info.

classes.name: VideoDmpReader
classes.description: Main class for reading and parsing video data from DMP files, providing access to media stream info and access units.

classes.name: AccessUnit
classes.description: Base class representing a generic media access unit with timestamp and data.

classes.name: AudioAccessUnit
classes.description: Derived class representing an audio access unit with additional audio sample info.

classes.name: VideoAccessUnit
classes.description: Derived class representing a video access unit with additional video sample info.

classes.name: DmpInfo
classes.description: Internal struct holding metadata about the DMP file, such as codecs, bitrates, durations, and access unit counts.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: Internal class managing a cache of DMP info associated with filenames.

methods.name: VideoDmpReader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the reader with filename and options.

methods.name: audio_codec
methods.description: Returns the audio codec used in the media.

methods.name: video_stream_info
methods.description: Returns the video stream information, ensuring samples are loaded.

methods.name: audio_mime_type
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for audio.

methods.name: audio_duration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the audio stream.

methods.name: video_fps
methods.description: Returns the frames per second of the video.

methods.name: video_mime_type
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for video.

methods.name: video_duration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the video stream.

methods.name: number_of_audio_buffers
methods.description: Returns the number of audio access units.

methods.name: number_of_video_buffers
methods.description: Returns the number of video access units.

methods.name: GetPlayerSampleInfo
methods.description: Retrieves sample info for a given media type and index.

methods.name: GetAudioSampleInfo
methods.description: Retrieves audio sample info for a given index.
